name: Wood Revival Desk Company
description: was established in 1979 with the purpose of reviving solid, creative, quality built furniture. All of our products are available in Cherry, Maple, Mahogany, Black Walnut, Quarter Sawn White Oak and Red Oak. We offer a variety of finishes that accent the natural beauty of the wood and we use time proven techniques in our wood working that are efficient and strong. We are dedicated to what we do and believe that the true cost of our product is proven over time.

name: Woodco Furniture
description: is a family owned and operated business that was founded in 1977 by Bob Pierce and his son Bobby. Woodco Furniture is made in the USA, right in Van Buren and Fort Smith, AR. This is the best way to control excellence, quality and cost. 100% of our lumber is slow-grown hardwood harvested in the Northern Appalachian Mountains, where natural sustainable forestry is practiced, and all our wood is kiln dried for accurate aging and moisture content. Woodco products are available in red oak, maple, cherry and quarter sawn white oak, and can be customized to meet your furniture needs. Our desire is to produce American Made furniture that will not only bring beauty and enjoyment to your home, but will surely become a family heirloom.
